description: A refined Parisian-influenced dining room with a clean, architectural presence. The walls are finished in smooth cream-white with tall applied moulding panels running full height — a classic Haussmann-style treatment that adds elegant depth. To the right, a built-in glass-front cabinet with ribbed glass inserts and a painted white frame is recessed into the wall. A large abstract textile art panel in greige, tan, and cream with a geometric color-block composition hangs on the feature wall. The round dining table is in rich dark walnut with a thick cylindrical pedestal base and ample diameter, topped with a shallow textured ceramic bowl holding three yellow pears. Four dining armchairs in solid dark walnut with curved backs, tapered legs, and cream upholstered seat cushions surround the table. The floor is a wide-plank herringbone-laid pale wood. A soft even luminosity glows from a warm overhead source, casting gentle light across the walnut table surface and picking out the grain of the wood.
